_about: Abilities whose text states a conditional bonus with no reading on their units (verify/readings.js): known gaps, for the owner to read against GW's text and give a reading or declare none needed. Not filled in by the tools. Keyed by check, ability, and the fingerprints of its text and of the sentence.

conditional|Treason of Tzeentch|844fa497.sentence: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

conditional|Errant’s Duty|54db6f62|7359d.sentence: While a model is affected by this ability, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that model and ranged weapons equipped by that model have the [ASSAULT] ability.

conditional|Paladin’s Duty|0529a76a|0508.sentence: While a model is affected by this ability, weapons equipped by that model have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and melee weapons equipped by that model have the [LANCE] ability.

conditional|Warden’s Duty|f4e10bae|f6d9e.sentence: While a model is affected by this ability, weapons equipped by that model have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and ranged weapons equipped by that model have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

conditional|Atrapos’ Duty|7522a4f2|7522a.sentence: While a model is affected by this ability, each time that model makes an attack that targets a TITANIC or TOWERING model, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

conditional|Crusader’s Duty|cb466686|cb4.sentence: While a model is affected by this ability, each time that model makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

conditional|Soul Sight|a4058129|e894edcd.sentence: In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: Select one visible enemy unit. Ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].
